page.overview:
Who is Gale Beaufort?

Gale Beaufort is one of the characters in Cars 3. Gale appears to be a metallic jet black futuristic-looking truck with the number 20 and cerulean lines.

"As part of Jackson Storm's winning team, Gale Beaufort represents the ultimate in Next-Gen transporters as seen in this detailed die cast. When Gale is paired with Storm, their team is set to blow away the competition."
